item.title: A week on the Skye trail
item.description: I did not expect to come back with any photographs at all. The forecast for the week read like a dare — five days of “showers”, two of “rain” — and Skye does not need encouragement to live up to it. But the weather on the island moves faster than the forecast, and between the fronts the light arrived in short, unbelievable bursts.
